Explanation:  
The question asks for the state where the losing team of the World Series three years before "Old Shufflefoot" (Fielder Jones) managed his team to victory is located. Fielder Jones managed the Chicago White Sox to victory in 1906. Three years prior to that is 1903, when the Pittsburgh Pirates (from Pennsylvania) lost the World Series. The Predicted Answer correctly identifies the Pirates and Pennsylvania as the answer. However, the Ground Truth Answer is "Illinois," which is the home state of the Chicago White Sox (the winning team in 1906), not the losing team in 1903. Therefore, the information from the Ground Truth Answer ("Illinois") does not appear in any form in the Predicted Answer, as the Predicted Answer gives "Pennsylvania" instead.

Decision: FALSE
